title: Glendale Resort Estate | Pool, Theater & Golf, 20+
description: Experience the ultimate 3-story Glendale resort retreat designed for unforgettable group stays! This fully furnished 6BR home sleeps 20+ guests with 13 beds and 2.5 baths. Enjoy a private pool with diving board, hot tub, 3-hole putting green, giant outdoor chess, dining area, lounge seating, and patio furniture. Inside features a full kitchen, bar area, pool table, foosball, and a private movie theater with vintage popcorn machine. Perfect for family reunions, retreats, and celebrations!
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

We had an amazing stay! They were very communicative and answered every question we had quickly. The house was beautiful, spotless, and exactly as described. They were also kind enough to let us check in a little early and check out a little later, which helped us out a lot and made our trip much smoother. We really appreciated their hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The house was incredibly spacious, giving everyone plenty of room to relax and enjoy our time together. The kids absolutely loved the amenities, especially the movie theater pool and the outdoor space—it was the perfect place for them to play while the adults could unwind. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, family-friendly getaway!

Talk about making great use of space!! We rented this place for a family get together 4 adults and 10 kids!!! We couldn’t even tell the kids were there! They had so much fun in the movie theater and the popcorn machine was definitely a plus! They swam, watched movies, played giant chess! The activities were endless ! The house was able to accommodate all of us and it was just overall an amazing weekend, we will definitely be going back!
Had a great stay , felt right at home . Manny was responsive when we messaged .
We had an extended family trip out to Phoenix to visit family. It was the perfect location in a great neighborhood.  The house was great!
